plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.À l'ajout d'une commande, ses changement: When a command is added, its state changes are imported from the Jeedom history over this number of days (if the command is historized). Default 90.
plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.Les changements d'état plus anciens sont: Older state changes are deleted every night: habits follow the season. Default 90, minimum 7.
plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.Un allumage plus long est pris pour une: A longer switch-on is taken as a missed switch-off (box stopped, bridge offline): it is discarded, and the days it touches are not counted for this lamp. Default 18.

plugins/presencehabituelle/core/class/pr.Période illisible (attendu AAAA-MM-JJ HH: Unreadable period (expected YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM → YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM)

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Réponse illisible : session expirée ? Re: Unreadable answer: session expired? Reload the page.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Déconseillé : pas un geste de présence: Not recommended: not a sign of presence
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Rien à reprendre : l’analyse part de l’e: Nothing to import: the analysis starts when saved
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Jeedom remplace ses valeurs par une moye: Jeedom replaces its values with an hourly average after a few hours: only the last hours are imported. Set its smoothing to “None” (command configuration, History tab).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Aucune lumière ni aucun volet trouvé : r: No light or shutter found: set the generic type of their state commands, or show the other commands.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Pas encore assez de données (un jour ent: Not enough data yet (at least one full day).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Allumée au moins une fois à chaque heure: On at least once at every hour.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.heures où elle l’est au plus 10 % des jo: hours when it is on at most 10 % of days
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Exceptions : jours loin de la moitié cen: Exceptions: days far from the middle half (more than 30 min, or 1.5 times its spread).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Week-end : matins du samedi et du dimanc: Weekend: Saturday and Sunday mornings, Friday and Saturday evenings. A partial closing (against the sun) does not count.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Effacer les changements d’état relevés e: Erase the recorded state changes and computed trends? The choice of commands is kept; the Jeedom history is not imported again.

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Tout est calculé sur cette box : le plug: Everything is computed on this box: the plugin sends nothing to anyone, and only administrators can see the trends (they are part of the Jeedom backups, like the rest of the database). For now the plugin draws from your history the trends, the exceptions and what never happens: it does not switch on or close anything yet.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Cochez les lumières et les volets à anal: Tick the lights and shutters to analyse. Plugs and media are offered unticked: a plug may power a fridge or a router, that is not presence. Sensors are not used: they say nothing about what you do.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Groupe : les lampes d'un même groupe son: Group: lamps of the same group are analysed together (a room). Empty = the lamp alone.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Vos absences (et toute période où une si: Your absences (and any period when a simulation was running) distort the trends: those days are not counted.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Commande info vraie pendant une absence: Info command that is true during an absence (e.g. an “Away” or “Holiday” mode): its active periods are excluded. Optional.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Une par ligne : AAAA-MM-JJ HH:MM → AAAA-: One per line: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM → YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (time is optional). Any day touched is excluded entirely.
